topic: missed call text back for contractors
hook: POV: you're up on a roof, your phone rings, and you can't answer.
caption:
Missed-call text back for contractors: comment TEXT and I'll reply with how it works.

Tuesday, 2:40 PM. You're halfway up a roof in Tulsa when the phone buzzes. Can't grab it. That caller probably won't leave a voicemail. They'll try the next roofer on Google.

This robot texts them back within 5 seconds of the missed call, asks what's wrong, and has the whole story waiting when you climb down at 4.

Works for roofers, HVAC techs, plumbers. Built in n8n, runs 24/7.

#contractor #roofing #smallbusinesstips #automation #n8n
